AyudaGrow Privacy Policy

How we handle personal information across our website, enquiries and customer accounts.

Website: https://www.ayudagrow.com | Last updated: 13 November 2026

Ayuda Grow LLC operates AyudaGrow. This policy explains how we collect and use personal information when you visit our website, enquire about our services, sign up or manage your account.

Who we are and how to contact us

Ayuda Grow LLC is registered in Florida. Business address: 7901 Fourth Street North, St. Petersburg, Florida, United States. We are responsible for the personal information used to manage our website enquiries and customer relationships. For privacy questions or requests, email admin@ayudagrow.com or call +1 876-480-0413.

Who this policy covers

This policy covers website visitors, prospective customers and account holders. Businesses using AyudaGrow are responsible for explaining how they use information about their own customers. Requests concerning those records should be directed to the relevant business.

Information we collect

Signup forms collect your first name, last name, phone number, account email and business name. Enquiries and account administration can also include correspondence, chat messages, service requirements, support information and subscription or payment records. Visiting the website or using embedded forms and chat can generate technical information, such as your IP address, browser, device and connection details.

Please provide only information needed for your enquiry or service. Do not submit passwords, payment-card details, patient information or other sensitive customer records through website chat, general enquiries or signup forms. Without the contact or account details needed for a request, we may be unable to respond or provide the requested service.

How we use information

We use personal information to respond to enquiries, follow up on services you request, manage signup and onboarding, administer accounts and billing, provide support and send service communications. We also use relevant records to meet legal obligations and address payment or service disputes.

Our handling of information depends on the purpose and applicable law, including steps requested before entering a contract, providing contracted services, meeting legal obligations and obtaining consent where required. Permission to receive promotions is separate from signup and service communications. You can contact admin@ayudagrow.com to withdraw marketing permission or ask us to stop promotional contact.

Payments

Payments are completed through Stripe. Payment-card details are entered on Stripe, not in the AyudaGrow signup form. We use relevant payment confirmations and subscription information to administer your account. Stripe explains its handling of personal information at https://stripe.com/privacy.

Website chat and AI

Our website assistant uses artificial intelligence to answer general questions about AyudaGrow. Messages and contact details you choose to provide are processed through HighLevel and the AI service providers supporting the assistant to generate responses and handle your enquiry. Authorised team members may review conversations to respond, provide support or follow up on your request.

AI responses can contain mistakes. For help from a person or confirmation of service details, email admin@ayudagrow.com or call +1 876-480-0413. Chat transcripts are kept for 12 months after the conversation ends, subject to the limited exceptions below.

Who receives information

We use Hostinger for website hosting, HighLevel for CRM, embedded signup and chat services, and Stripe for payments. The AI providers supporting HighLevel process chat information as needed to operate the assistant. Business email services carry correspondence you send to us. Relevant information may also be disclosed where legally required or necessary to establish, exercise or defend legal claims.

We do not sell personal information. We do not share phone numbers or marketing consent with third parties for their own marketing or promotional purposes. Service providers may process contact information on our behalf to deliver the services described in this policy.

International processing

Personal information may be processed outside your country. HighLevel lists infrastructure in the United States and support processing in India. Its Data Processing Agreement sets out confidentiality, security, subprocessor and transfer provisions, including jurisdiction-specific safeguards where applicable. The services used determine which subprocessors handle information.

HighLevel’s processing terms and current subprocessor list are available at https://www.gohighlevel.com/data-processing-agreement and https://www.gohighlevel.com/sub-processors. Contact admin@ayudagrow.com for questions about the handling of your information across borders.

Cookies and browser storage

The website uses session storage to remember page position and selections. Embedded signup forms, the chat widget and Stripe checkout may also use cookies, browser storage and connection information to operate their services. Your browser settings allow you to manage cookies and clear stored data. Blocking storage can affect form, chat or checkout functionality.

We do not deploy Google Analytics 4 or Meta advertising tags on this website. This statement concerns our website tags and does not mean embedded services operate without cookies or technical data collection. We will update this policy before introducing new analytics or advertising tools and provide consent controls where required.

Security

We use reasonable technical and organisational safeguards to protect personal information against unauthorised access, misuse, loss or disclosure. No internet service or storage system can guarantee complete security. Keep your login details private and contact us if you suspect unauthorised use of your account.

Children

AyudaGrow is a business service and is not directed at children. If you believe a child has provided personal information through our website, contact admin@ayudagrow.com so we can review and address it.

How long we keep information

Our retention periods are based on the type of record and the purpose for keeping it:

Personal information retention periods
InformationRetention period
Website chat transcripts12 months after the conversation ends.
Enquiries and leads that do not become customers24 months after the last meaningful contact. Automated messages sent by us do not restart this period.
Active account informationFor the customer relationship, while needed to provide and administer the service.
Closed account operational data90 days after closure, then deleted from active systems.
Marketing opt-out recordsIndefinitely, limited to what is needed to prevent further marketing, such as the email address or phone number, channel and opt-out date.

Necessary billing and tax records may be retained separately for applicable legal and accounting requirements. Records needed for an actual dispute or legal obligation may be kept for that purpose. These exceptions do not require retaining an entire customer profile.

Archived provider backups are separate from active systems. HighLevel’s processing terms provide for retained customer data to remain protected and isolated from further processing, except as legally required. A valid deletion request may require action before a normal retention period ends.

Your privacy requests and complaints

Depending on applicable law, you may request access to or correction of your information, deletion, restriction of or objection to processing, or withdrawal of consent. Email admin@ayudagrow.com with the request and the account or interaction it concerns. We may ask for information needed to verify your identity. Please do not send passwords or payment-card details.

We handle requests within the periods required by applicable law. Some information may need to be retained for legal reasons. You can also complain to the relevant data protection authority, including Jamaica’s Office of the Information Commissioner where Jamaican law applies: https://www.oic.gov.jm.

Changes to this policy

We publish updates on this page and revise the last-updated date. Where legally required, we also notify affected account holders of material changes.

For more about cookies and browser storage, read our Cookie Policy.
